title: Parking Bundle Credit on Like-Program Lease Term Agreement Renewals
content:
A like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement earns a parking bundle credit, subtracted from the offered rent in fixing the contracted rent. The parking bundle credit is set by the household's active parking license: a Structured Garage Space, EV Charging Reserved Space or Private Detached Garage earns 15.00 dollars a month; any other active parking license earns 7.50 dollars a month; a household with no active parking license earns no credit.

## Credit by Parking License product

| Active Parking License product | Parking bundle credit |
|---|---|
| Structured Garage Space | 15.00 dollars a month |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 15.00 dollars a month |
| Private Detached Garage | 15.00 dollars a month |
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 7.50 dollars a month |
| Surface Reserved Space | 7.50 dollars a month |
| Covered Carport Space | 7.50 dollars a month |
| No active Parking License | none |

Only a Parking License in active status counts; a license that is waitlisted, suspended, on notice, terminated or withdrawn is not an active parking license.

*Illustrations (hypothetical).* A household with an active Covered Carport Space earns 7.50 dollars a month. A household whose only Parking License is waitlisted for a Structured Garage Space earns no credit.
